podcast.body: Released as a major hit A-side, its B-side was the equally significant "Strawberry Fields Forever." This pairing is a prime example of The Beatles' double A-side strategy, where both songs were of high commercial and artistic merit. "For example, when the Beatles released Penny Lane, Big Hit, the B side was strawberry fields forever."

podcast.body: The release of this single in 1967, along with the "Sgt. Pepper" album, helped reignite fan enthusiasm for The Beatles, contributing to their second imperial phase. "But then in 1967, the One Two Punch of the Penny Lane single and the Sergeant Pepper album reignited fans Love of the Fab Four."
